headline.label: IMRS production V2: factor model + USD/UZS U-MIDAS
headline.formula: 0.5 x Dynamic factor model, 8 series (production V2) + 0.5 x U-MIDAS(3): USD/UZS on published GDP (production V2)
headline.description: IMRS's production nowcast (version 2), run by the Hub: the average of a dynamic factor model and a MIDAS regression on the exchange rate. The factor model extracts one common factor, with two-month dynamics estimated by maximum likelihood, from eight monthly series -- SIAT's industrial production volume index, producer prices, the USD/UZS and RUB/UZS exchange rates, the world gold price, broad money, foreign-currency reserves and POS card payments (not used after 2024) -- handles the months not yet released, and relates the factor's quarterly mean to GDP growth together with the previous quarter's growth. The U-MIDAS regression relates GDP growth to its previous value and the last three monthly changes of the USD/UZS rate. Both are estimated on the GDP figures as SIAT had published them at each forecast date.
headline.selection: Adopted on 7 October 2026 at IMRS's request: IMRS's production nowcast V2 (specification M0, policy COMBO_50_50; github.com/mrshohruh/uzbekistan_nowcast, commit 0edd6b0). IMRS promoted it on a matched out-of-sample comparison of 12 origins (2025Q3-2026Q2, stages H1-H3, standard lags, scored against SIAT's first release), where its RMSE was 0.583 against 0.678 for the factor model alone, 0.686 for the U-MIDAS alone and 0.701 for IMRS's previous production model. The Hub runs the same specification on its own copies of the inputs and reproduces the production forecasts: the current nowcast to 1e-10, and the 102 factor-model and 96 U-MIDAS forecasts of the production record to 2e-8. Its record on the Hub's evaluation window is in the accuracy tables; the two previous headlines are still reported.

experimental.label: PCA factor model (Tiers A-C + night lights), experimental
experimental.spec: experimental: the Tier A-C PCA factor model with night-time light radiance (VIIRS, y/y log growth, 30-day lag) added to its factor panel; not a member of any combination
experimental.evidence: Research run of 2 October 2026 (standard lags, 2022Q1-2026Q2, 18 quarters): RMSE 0.590 against 0.656 for the same model without night lights (-10%); the whole gain came in 2022-2024 (0.535 against 0.641) and none in 2025Q1-2026Q2 (0.686 against 0.686); Clark-West p = 0.16. Not conclusive, hence experimental.
experimental.rule: Re-estimated and re-scored in every fortnightly run. Each GDP quarter SIAT publishes enters its comparison with the baseline (PCA factor model (Tiers A-C, 1 factor)) on the same quarters and stages. Quarters from 2026Q3 on were not published when the model was added on 2026-10-05, so they are a clean re-test (trial window). Review after 8 trial quarters: keep it only if its pooled RMSE in the trial window is below the baseline's under both release-lag rules; it never enters a combination or the headline before that review.

experimental.label: PCA factor model (real activity + M2 + USD/UZS), experimental
experimental.spec: experimental: PCA factor model on real-activity series only (industry total, manufacturing, mining, utilities, retail and wholesale trade) plus M2 and USD/UZS, which anchor the factor before the activity series start (2020-21); the price, reserve, RUB/UZS and gold series of Tiers A-C are left out; not a member of any combination
experimental.evidence: Research run of 6 October 2026 (standard lags, 2022Q1-2026Q2, 18 quarters): RMSE 0.621 against 0.656 for the Tier A-C factor model; better in 2022-2024 (0.610 against 0.641) and in 2025Q1-2026Q2 (0.644 against 0.686), mostly at H3 (0.508 against 0.635); no gain at H1. The series set was chosen after looking at these quarters, hence experimental.

flash.label: Flash estimate: ensemble + bottom-up with the quarter's data complete
flash.formula: 0.5 x Ensemble: AR(2) + USD/UZS U-MIDAS (H3) + 0.5 x Year-to-date bottom-up, flash (quarter's data complete)
flash.origin_rule: quarter end + 33 days (the longest indicator release lag; + 15 days under conservative lags): the third month of the quarter is out for every indicator
flash.description: The year-to-date bottom-up model once the quarter's monthly data are complete, averaged with the ensemble. It arrives about when SIAT publishes GDP (about 31 days after the quarter), so it is a check of what the quarter's industry, construction and trade data imply, not an early forecast; it never replaces the headline. Most of its gain over H3 is in first quarters, which use their January-March indices only at this stage (Q1 RMSE 0.65 at H3, 0.25 here, 2022-2026); for Q2-Q4 the complete quarter adds little (0.35 to 0.33).

model_specs.prod_v2_combination: 0.5 x dynamic factor model + 0.5 x USD/UZS U-MIDAS, both on the GDP figures published at the origin (IMRS production V2, COMBO_50_50; the headline since 7 October 2026)
model_specs.prod_v2_dfm: 1 factor AR(2), EM maximum likelihood (500 iterations, tol 1e-5) on 8 series standardised over the training months (industrial volume index, PPI, USD/UZS, RUB/UZS, Pink Sheet gold, M2, FX reserves ex gold, POS turnover to 2024-12), panel from 2019-01, balanced start, >=36 training months; Kalman-filtered factor; y_t = c + a fbar_t + b y_(t-1) on the published GDP figures (>=12 rows); fails if not converged or the spectral radius is >= 0.9999 (production PHASE6C_DFM)
model_specs.prod_v2_umidas: y_t = a + b y_(t-1) + sum_(l=0..2) g_l x_(m(t,h)-l), x = USD/UZS monthly log change, on the GDP figures published at the origin from 2018Q3; >=15 rows (production UMIDAS_USD)
model_specs.prod_v2_combination_dev: 0.5439 x production V2 factor model + 0.4561 x production V2 U-MIDAS (development-sample weights of the production repository, COMBO_DEV_WEIGHT)
model_specs.bu_kalman_combination: 0.5 x year-to-date bottom-up model + 0.5 x Kalman factor model (activity, real M2, USD/UZS) (headline 6-7 October 2026)
model_specs.ytd_bottom_up: y_t = sum_s w_s g_s (production identity, year to date); w_s = section share in GDP over the same months of the previous year; Q2-Q4 g_s = previous quarter's growth + change of the section's monthly SIAT index since then (industry B-E, construction, trade), else the previous quarter's growth; Q1 g_s = mean of the last two annual growth rates; nothing estimated
model_specs.dfm_kalman_activity: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; Kalman-filter DFM, 1 factor AR(1), EM, on 8 series: industry total, manufacturing, mining, utilities, retail and wholesale trade (y/y log), real M2 (M2 y/y log minus 12-month CPI inflation, CPI from January 2019) and USD/UZS (m/m log); quarterly form: single-quarter growth on its previous value and the quarterly factor, converted to year to date
model_specs.ytd_combination: 0.5 x ensemble (AR(2) + USD/UZS U-MIDAS) + 0.5 x year-to-date bottom-up model (headline until 6 October 2026)
model_specs.ar2: y_t = a + b1 y_(t-1) + b2 y_(t-2), OLS (accuracy benchmark)
model_specs.historical_mean: mean of all GDP quarters before the target
model_specs.umidas_usd_uzs_mom_dlog: y_t = a + b y_(t-1) + sum_(l=0..2) g_l x_(m(t,h)-l), x = USD/UZS monthly log change; >=15 rows
model_specs.almon_usd_uzs_mom_dlog: USD/UZS U-MIDAS(3) with g_l = t0 + t1 l/2 (Almon, degree 1); >=12 rows
model_specs.dfm_kalman: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; Kalman-filter DFM, 1 factor AR(1), EM, 19 Tier A-C indicators; y on y_(t-1) and the quarterly factor
model_specs.dfm_tierA_k1: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; EM principal-components factor model, Tier A indicators, 1 factor; y on y_(t-1) and the quarterly factor
model_specs.dfm_tierB_k1: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; same, Tier A-B indicators
model_specs.dfm_tierC_k1: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; same, Tier A-C indicators
model_specs.dfm_tierC_k1_ntl: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; experimental: the Tier A-C PCA factor model with night-time light radiance (VIIRS, y/y log growth, 30-day lag) added to its factor panel; not a member of any combination
model_specs.dfm_activity_k1: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; experimental: PCA factor model on real-activity series only (industry total, manufacturing, mining, utilities, retail and wholesale trade) plus M2 and USD/UZS, which anchor the factor before the activity series start (2020-21); the price, reserve, RUB/UZS and gold series of Tiers A-C are left out; not a member of any combination
model_specs.bvar: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; BVAR(1) in GDP, industrial production, M2, USD/UZS (quarterly means); Minnesota NIW prior lambda=0.2; conditional on released target-quarter indicators; 2,000 draws
model_specs.lasso_bridge: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; Lasso, quarterly means of visible months + y_(t-1), CV (time-series) on training rows
model_specs.enet_bridge: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; Elastic net (l1 ratio 0.2/0.5/0.8), same design
model_specs.lasso_umidas: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; Lasso, last 3 visible monthly values of each indicator + y_(t-1)
model_specs.enet_umidas: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; Elastic net, same monthly-lag design
model_specs.bridge_ar_mean: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; equal-weight average of 19 single-indicator bridges; unreleased months AR(p<=3, BIC)-forecast
model_specs.bridge_ar_invmse: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; inverse-MSE weighted average of the same bridges (>=4 past errors)
model_specs.midas_expalmon_mean: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; equal-weight average of 19 MIDAS equations with 6 lags, exponential Almon weights (grid NLS)
model_specs.midas_expalmon_invmse: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; inverse-MSE weighted average of the same
model_specs.midas_beta_mean: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; same with Beta weights
model_specs.midas_beta_invmse: quarterly form: estimated on the single quarter's growth g, nowcast (1 - w) y_(t-1) + w g_hat; inverse-MSE weighted average of the Beta MIDAS equations
model_specs.combo_equal: equal-weight average of: ar2, umidas_usd_uzs_mom_dlog, dfm_kalman, bridge_ar_mean, lasso_bridge, enet_bridge, lasso_umidas, enet_umidas, bvar, midas_expalmon_mean, midas_beta_mean
model_specs.combo_invmse: inverse-MSE weighted average of the same pool (>=4 past errors per member)

notes: SIAT monthly tables are stored as published (year-to-date cumulative under 'YYYY-MM' codes); panel.py de-cumulates them to monthly flows before computing growth rates.

gold_price: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly average (dataset wb-pinksheet-monthly, since 7 October 2026; before, a proxy from CBU monetary gold per troy ounce). It enters the headline's factor model and the multi-indicator models.

pos_turnover: CBU bulletin table 6.4 from 2020 spliced with the same table of the 2018 and 2019 bulletins (2017-2019), so its growth starts in 2018. The headline's factor model withholds it after 2024-12, as the production model it reproduces does.
russia_ipi: Rosstat is not collected, so this registry variable is not used.
Deposits, credit and payment series come from the CBU statistical bulletin (monthly history since 2020) plus the latest monthly snapshots; the most recent months can have gaps.
USD/RUB: the CBU archive has one rate per week until Feb-2021 and one per business day afterwards. The month in progress is flagged partial and set to NaN.
Release-lag rule: a monthly value for month m with registry lag L is usable at origin O iff end(m) + L <= O (standard) or end(m) + max(L + 15, 3) <= O (conservative).

Nowcasts use standard lags. From 2021Q1 every model trains on the GDP quarters from 2018Q1 (SIAT 3698); the early track record (2018Q1-2020Q4) trains on every quarter from 2016Q1 (SIAT 3122 before 2018), and each model enters it once its own minimum training sample is met.

Target forms: the benchmarks, the USD/UZS ensemble and the headline's two models are estimated on the published year-to-date growth y; every other model on the growth of the single quarter g, y_q = (1 - w_q) y_(q-1) + w_q g_q with w_q the quarter's share in last year's same-period nominal GDP, and its nowcast is converted with the published y_(q-1).

GDP information: the headline's two models (IMRS production V2) train on the GDP figures as published at each origin (the documented record of first releases and revisions from 2018Q3, and every new quarter or revision the Hub records); every other model trains on the latest figures. All models are scored against the latest figures; the headline also against the first release (gdp_vintages).
The month in progress of the daily exchange-rate series is partial and not used.

gdp_vintages.note: First releases and later revisions of SIAT's year-to-date GDP growth come from the documented record compiled by IMRS (stat.uz press releases, 2018Q3-2026Q2) and, from the Hub's first run on 7 October 2026, from every figure the Hub reads in SIAT table 3698. 'Latest' is the figure the Hub has today; the headline's training data at each origin are the figures published by then (information set).
